text_block_list.text:
Tickets to a play, given to me by the hotel manager
when I previously had dinner with members of the Mejiro family.
Today, I had come to watch that play, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"A greeting?
Thanks for going out of your way."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No. ...By the way,
may I ask you about the other day's race?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about some black tea in the lobby?
We still have time before the show begins♪

"...What a dazzling, magnificent place.
Perhaps out of nervousness, it makes me feel restless, but—"
choice_data_list: (If I want to stand beside Ramonu...)

text_block_list.text:
Thinking that, I straightened my posture.
My goal is to be like her that night we had dinner at the hotel—thrillingly cool.

However... surely just doing something like this
won't grant me elegance like hers.
choice_data_list: (What else should I be careful about?)
(What else should I watch out for?)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: “—First, try relaxing your shoulders a little more!”

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ I'm sorry.
It was just written all over your face:
"I want to become just like Ramonu-san."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Which is why,
I have one more piece of advice for you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
To put it simply!
—'Grace is born from composure', you know♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. Take a closer look at Ramonu-san.
What do you think she's doing?"

"I'm just drinking black tea like normal,"
I started to reply—before suddenly realizing.

Though she's only moving her eyes,
it feels as though she's been quietly watching her surroundings the entire time.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Looking around like that—
(CRASH!)

text_block_list.name: Theater Staff
text_block_list.text:
I-I am terribly sorry...!
Are you hurt at all!?
Did any shards or hot water get on you...!?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: No, not particularly.

text_block_list.name: Theater Staff
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry! Please forgive me...!
I'll clean this right up... and then get you a new seat!

In that instant, a heavy tension fills the air.
Everyone turned their eyes toward Mejiro Ramonu,
waiting for her judgment... or so it seemed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: The only things that got wet were you and the floor.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: There is no need to make a fuss.

text_block_list.name: Theater Staff
text_block_list.text:
! ...My sincerest apologies once again.
Thank you very much for your kind words.
I will prepare your seats immediately.

...Swept up by Mejiro Ramonu's composure,
the atmosphere in the lobby
completely settled down.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—By keeping track of the situation at all times,
you can maintain your own pace no matter what happens.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That composure turns into poise, which gives birth to true grace.
...Isn't that right!

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"—The performance will begin shortly.
Guests who are out of their seats, please..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look at the time!
I must return to my seat... Please excuse me.

After the play concluded to thunderous applause,
we moved over to the theater's salon lounge.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That opening solo was amazing!
Your voice had such incredible reach, I could hardly believe you're a newcomer~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Maybe I'll come back to see them
when the buds begin to open.

Watching the girls from the side as they discussed their impressions of the play,
I decided to put into practice what I had just learned.
choice_data_list: (First, I need to check our surroundings—)

text_block_list.text:
—Just then, I saw a man approaching.
He didn't seem like someone I knew, though.

text_block_list.name: Pompous Man
text_block_list.text: Is it true that you are Mejiro Ramonu-kun's Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yes, I am currently serving in that capacity.

text_block_list.name: Pompous Man
text_block_list.text:
Then allow me to say this.
Be extremely careful in your guidance.
Crushing her talent is something that must never—

Their tremendous momentum almost makes me flinch.
No... I can't let them break my rhythm here.
If I am to create an 'opening'—

text_block_list.name: Pompous Man
text_block_list.text:
!? ...No... well... you see.
In other words... I had high hopes for her...
choice_data_list: I will do my very best to serve.

text_block_list.name: Pompous Man
text_block_list.text:
...H-Hmph.
I'll hold you to those words, then.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: That is an appropriate response.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
She seems surprisingly tough.

text_block_list.name: Pompous Man
text_block_list.text:
!? ...Wh-What is it?
If you have something to say...
choice_data_list: Thank you very much for your passionate support.

text_block_list.name: Pompous Man
text_block_list.text:
! A-As long as you understand.
Though... perhaps I got a little too heated as well. My apologies.
choice_data_list: (Is this what they mean by creating a "pause"?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Snapping like that, how unusual.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yep, yep!
A perfect 100 points♪
